newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PT shares hit high for '97 before results.
newsitem.headline: PT shares hit high for '97 before results.

text.p: Portugal Telecom shares hit a high for 1997 of 6,400 escudos in anticipation of good results for 1996 and dealers said they expected the record share price to be surpassed easily.
"PT could easily trade above 6,400 escudos because there is strong demand before the presentation of the company's results on Wednesday," said one operator.
"The average market forecast for PT's 1996 profit is about 52 billion escudos, but if the results are slightly above this, the share price will hit new records," he added.
Operators said foreign investors were active buyers of PT shares.
Many analysts expect PT to post a 1996 profit of around 52 billion escudos, up from 36.2 billion in 1995, when it announces its results on Wednesday.
PT shares eased back slightly to 6,370 escudos, up 51, in volume of 107,196 at 1609 GMT.
